title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 6 — WORLD 8: B2 FLUENCY & REAL-WORLD MASTERY

targets.vocabulary: 2000+ active vocabulary with collocations, phrasal verbs, idioms, academic language and functional chunks
targets.reading: 1300–1500 words with inference, evaluation, tone and synthesis
targets.listening: 13–15 minutes of natural multi-speaker and authentic-style input
targets.speaking: 16–20 minute sustained interaction, discussion, negotiation and presentation
targets.writing: 400–500 words across argumentative, formal and reflective tasks
targets.presentation: 9–11 minutes with structured explanation and persuasion

grammar: advanced tense and aspect choices in extended discourse
advanced relative clauses and noun-phrase expansion
discourse markers, referencing and lexical cohesion
formal, neutral and informal register shifts
complex noun phrases and academic style

missions.title: B2 Fluency Vocabulary Reactor
missions.focus: Build automatic B2 vocabulary recall through collocations, phrasal verbs, idioms, word families and functional chunks.

missions.title: Tense & Aspect in Real Conversation
missions.focus: Control tense and aspect while switching naturally between background, events, completed actions and current relevance.

missions.title: Nuanced Modals & Modal Perfects
missions.focus: Express degrees of certainty, criticism, possibility, obligation and past inference with precise modal language.

missions.title: Hypothetical Worlds Challenge
missions.focus: Use mixed and extended conditionals to analyze imagined situations, consequences, regrets and alternative decisions.

missions.title: Information Transformation Lab
missions.focus: Transform statements using advanced passive, reporting verbs, impersonal structures and formal information patterns.

missions.title: Sentence Compression Mission
missions.focus: Combine and shorten complex ideas using participle clauses, reduced relatives and efficient noun phrases.

missions.title: Focus & Emphasis Command
missions.focus: Use inversion, cleft structures, fronting and emphasis patterns to control information focus.

missions.title: Cohesion Control Center
missions.focus: Create clear long-form communication with referencing, substitution, ellipsis, discourse markers and lexical cohesion.

missions.title: Register Shift Simulator
missions.focus: Rewrite and deliver the same message in informal, neutral, formal and diplomatic registers.

missions.title: B2 Fluency Conversation Arena
missions.focus: Maintain a sustained conversation by extending answers, asking follow-up questions, clarifying and reacting spontaneously.

missions.title: Reading Mastery — Evaluate & Synthesize
missions.focus: Compare viewpoints, identify evidence and assumptions, evaluate arguments and synthesize information across an extended text.

missions.title: Listening Mastery — Natural Speech
missions.focus: Understand connected natural speech, speaker attitude, implied meaning, interruptions and changing viewpoints.

missions.title: Argument Builder — B2 Essay
missions.focus: Write a 400–500 word argument with a clear thesis, developed evidence, concession, counterargument and strong conclusion.

missions.title: Professional Report & Recommendation
missions.focus: Analyze a realistic problem and produce a formal report containing findings, comparisons and practical recommendations.

missions.title: Persuasive Presentation Command
missions.focus: Deliver a 9–11 minute presentation that explains a complex topic, compares alternatives and persuades an audience.

missions.title: Digital World & Media Mission
missions.focus: Discuss social media, digital privacy, AI, online communication and media influence using nuanced B2 language.

missions.title: Travel, Services & Unexpected Problems
missions.focus: Solve realistic travel and public-service problems involving delays, complaints, changes, requests and negotiation.

missions.title: Negotiation, Mediation & Agreement
missions.focus: Manage disagreement, clarify priorities, make diplomatic proposals, negotiate compromises and reach a workable agreement.

missions.title: B2 Real-World Skills Marathon
missions.focus: Complete a multi-stage scenario combining reading, listening, spontaneous speaking, negotiation, formal writing and presentation.

missions.title: WORLD 8 MASTER QUEST — B2 REAL-WORLD MASTERY
missions.focus: Complete a final B2 mission requiring independent decisions, nuanced communication, evidence-based argument, negotiation and a polished final presentation.

realWorldScenarios: workplace meetings and professional problem solving
assessment: B2 grammar range, accuracy and flexibility
natural use of collocations and functional language
comprehension of explicit and implied meaning
ability to negotiate, justify and defend ideas
